raw_segments.text: Casca, a common slave you'd know him well by sight, held up his left hand, which did
flame and burn like twenty torches joined, and yet his hand, not sensible of fire, remained
Besides, I ha' not since put up my sword.
Against the capital I met a lion who glared upon me and went surly by without annoying
And there were drawn upon a heap a hundred ghastly women, transformed with their fear,
who swore they saw men, all in fire, walk up and down the streets.
And yesterday the bird of night did sit, even at noonday upon the market-place, hooting
When these prodigies do so conjointly meet, let not men say, these are their reasons,
they are natural, for I believe they are portentous things unto the climate that they point upon.
